title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes; version bumps
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: unify authentication and retry behavior across all official SDKs, improve streaming ergonomics (consistent async/iterator behavior), and fix small parity gaps between Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs. This PR consolidates retry logic into a shared pattern, adds token-refresh hooks for long-lived streaming connections, and bumps minor package versions for parity.

Summary of changes and goals: - Unify auth and retry semantics: consistent backoff defaults, idempotency handling for non-idempotent endpoints, and better 401/refresh flow. - Streaming ergonomics: Python/TS now expose async iterators with the same event model; Go exposes a context-aware stream reader with identical semantics. - Parity fixes: align parameter names, error types, and response wrapper shapes across SDKs. - Version bumps: minor patches for all 3 SDKs to publish the compatibility fixes.

Checklist: - [x] Implement shared retry policy in each SDK - [x] Add token refresh hook and tests for long streaming sessions - [x] Align API parameter names and docs for parity - [x] Add integration tests covering streaming reconnect + retry - [x] Bump versions and update changelogs - [x] Manual smoke test on Hosted API (staging)

Compatibility notes: All changes are backwards-compatible for common usage patterns. There are a few renamed optional parameters for parity (see docs/CHANGELOG entries). Migration notes added to SDK changelogs.

Testing: Unit tests added/updated for python/ts/go. Integration test harness run against staging, exercising streaming reconnect under 401 refresh and transient network errors. CI initially failed lint on TS; fixed in followup commit.

Why a monorepo change: SDK packages live under the monorepo and share some internal helper modules; keeping the change in a single PR made the cross-language parity work and release bumps easier to coordinate.
